caveats: the mapper is lexical and structural over a recovered candidate ontology freeze, not a production mapping system
120 expressions bound the resolution of every rate here
an ontology_ceiling below 1.0 caps every metric beneath it, so a low end-to-end figure may be an ontology result rather than a mapper result

gap_categories_from_annotation.episodic_experience_and_object_significa: a specific remembered occasion and the personal meaning attached to a place or a possession: a sunset watched with someone who has died, a tattoo standing for freedom, lucky shoes where every mark has a story. state.possession records that the object is held and nothing about what it means; no type carries an occasion as an experience
gap_categories_from_annotation.fictional_or_role_play_frame: role-play turns where the speaker voices a character. The propositions are real text but false of the subject, and the source_status vocabulary has no value for in-fiction content, so a mapper that extracts them pollutes memory with a persona's facts
gap_categories_from_annotation.generic_activity_or_pursuit: v2 types media consumption, relocation, commitment, life transition and objective completion, but has no event or state type for an ordinary activity, hobby or creative practice: recording a podcast, hosting a party, attending a retreat, a beach outing. Would require an activity event type with a participation role, plus a pursuit state type for the ongoing-practice reading
gap_categories_from_annotation.held_value_or_general_belief: a subject's priority ordering ('safety is super important to me') and their general causal beliefs about the world ('self-care makes you strong for tough times') are both memory-worthy and both untyped. attribute.assessment rates an entity's quality, which is a different claim, and modality.believed qualifies an assertion without giving the belief a subject-held type
gap_categories_from_annotation.positive_capability_or_skill: state.capability_constraint types what a subject cannot do; nothing types what they can. Skill level, competence and quantified progress ('completed 4 projects since starting classes', 'my skills are making a difference') have no home

graded_review: everything was labelled once; novel cases, genuine ambiguity, L2 abstractions and cases the annotator found hard carry an adjudication note. Clear cases were not double-reviewed, which is the effort bound the task set
l2_denominator_warning: gold names 5 L2 targets against 231 L1 references, so every L2 rate rests on very few cases and must be read with its denominator rather than compared to L1

layer_paths.l1: recognition from lexical and structural evidence
layer_paths.l2: derivation over attested L1 items through M_L1_to_L2
layer_paths.why_reported_separately: the two layers take different paths, so one figure spanning both would describe neither

candidate_recall.reading: when the target exists, does generation surface it at all

no_map.reading: gold none and out_of_scope both expect a decline but mean different things: none is content the ontology should not cover, out_of_scope is content it cannot. Mapping an out_of_scope expression is a ceiling failure wearing the costume of a false positive.

ontology_ceiling.reading: the share of gold targets the ontology contains. A mapper cannot recover what was never admitted, so this bounds every metric below it.

ranking_accuracy.reading: given recall, is the correct item first; isolates ranking from generation

run_discipline: one run over the frozen sample. No threshold was adjusted, no alias added, no output corrected, and the sample was not re-run. A second run after any change would measure the change.
